label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads at 18-under through 1 hole with Jackson Suber four back at -14 and a tight chase pack at -13, including Stephan Jaeger and Tom Hoge.

items.headline: Im's Hole-in-One
items.text: Sungjae Im aced the par-3 7th and eagled the 9th during a second-round 61 to reach 13-under, sharing the midway lead at THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson.

items.headline: Spieth’s Birdie Spree
items.text: Jordan Spieth carded a bogey-free 62 with six straight birdies on his second nine, rising to 12-under but sitting six shots behind leader Si Woo Kim.
